title: 2027: Sowore, Hashim, Adebayo Join Forces To Challenge Tinubu’s Presidency
desc: The presidential candidates of the Accord Party, African Action Congress (AAC) and Social Democratic Party (SDP) have resolved to work together towards building a common democratic force ahead of the 2027 presidential election. The candidates, namely Dr Gbenga Olawepo-Hashim of Accord, Omoyele Sowore of AAC and Prince Adewole Adebayo of SDP, reached the resolution after a meeting in Port Harcourt, Rivers State, during the weekend, where they deliberated on Nigeria’s democracy, economy and security.
